tests.description: Clicking 3 times chains Attack1->Attack2->Attack3 then returns to Idle
tests.name: Attack combo chains 1-2-3
source: harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack2', 'Second click chains to Attack2, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack3', 'Third click chains to Attack3, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Idle' || p.animation === 'Run', 'Combo ends back to Idle/Run, got '+p.animation);

tests.description: Combo works standing still; moving or jumping cancels the attack
tests.name: Attack cancel with move or jump
source: harness.assert(p.animation === 'Attack2', 'Second click chains to Attack2, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(stage && stage.value === 0, 'Moving cancels combo (stage 0), got '+(stage && stage.value));
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Run', 'Moving during attack switches to Run, got '+p.animation);
harness.assert(stage && stage.value === 0, 'Jump cancels combo (stage 0), got '+(stage && stage.value));
harness.assert(p.animation === 'Jump' || p.animation === 'Fall', 'Jump during attack switches to Jump/Fall, got '+p.animation);

tests.description: Blink dash moves ~150px, cooldown blocks spam, works after 0.5s
tests.name: Blink dash test
source: // Hold Shift then tap D for blink right
// Immediate second blink should be blocked by cooldown
harness.assert(Math.abs(x2 - x1) < 5, 'Cooldown blocks immediate second blink (moved ' + (x2 - x1) + ')');
// Wait 0.6s then blink again should work
harness.assert((x3 - x2) > 100, 'Blink works again after cooldown (moved ' + (x3 - x2) + ')');
